descriptionByLocale.en:
At Sunrise, we think bigger, go further and create new ideas. For us working culture means achieving great things together. It’s where respect and innovative ideas combine with real teamwork – every voice counts, every perspective makes us stronger. Our passion spurs us on to try new things and grow continuously. Sound like you? Then join our success story.

Join our IT Customer Relation Platforms team and take the lead in shaping the future of Sunrise’s Contact Center platforms. As a Senior Tech Lead, you will drive innovation and ensure seamless customer interactions powered by cutting-edge CCaaS technologies. You will work at the intersection of technology, business, and operations, making a direct impact on customer experience. A key highlight: you will own a mission-critical platform used every day to serve thousands of customers.

YOUR CHALLENGE:

- Own and lead the Contact Center, Chatbot, Voicebot platforms, including architecture, roadmap, and continuous improvements
- Design and implement API integrations with internal systems and third-party applications
- Plan and execute releases, rollouts, and major platform changes ensuring stability and performance
- Monitor platform health proactively and ensure high availability and operational excellence
- Govern projects and change requests, including cost and timeline reviews
- Act as the main escalation point between internal teams and external partners (e.g., external partners, platform providers)
- Lead and support the team, ensuring efficient incident handling and SLA adherence

YOUR SKILLS:

- Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
- Proven experience in managing and operating contact center platforms (Sprinklr environments preferred)
- Strong knowledge of API integration, system architecture, and enterprise IT landscapes
- Experience in project governance, vendor management, and delivery oversight
- Familiarity with IT service management tools (e.g., Remedy, Octane) and incident processes
- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills across technical and business teams
- Fluent in English (spoken and written); German is an advantage

At Sunrise, you’ll be working in a dynamic and multinational environment where every voice is heard, perspectives are shared and values are lived. Diversity isn’t just a program for us, it’s part of our DNA. By celebrating our differences, we achieve great things together.

Sunrise has partnered with «Advance – Gender Equality in Business». We’ve also been awarded the Swiss LGBTI label and «Fair-ON-Pay Advanced» certification as recognition for offering all our employees equal pay for work of equal value.

Ready to rise to the challenge? Then join the team and actively shape our future!

#ChallengersWanted

Information for agencies: Application dossiers sent or uploaded by placement agencies or similar are not desired, will therefore not be considered and will be deleted. #LI-SJ1

jobs.title: P2P Desk Manager 80-100%
jobs.description:
A Sunrise, pensiamo più grande, e oltre e creare nuove idee. Per noi la cultura del lavoro significa raggiungere grandi cose insieme. È dove il rispetto e le idee innovative si combinano con il lavoro di squadra reale – ogni voce conta, ogni prospettiva ci rende più forti. La nostra passione ci spinge a provare cose nuove e a crescere rapidamente. Ti sembra? Allora unisciti alla nostra storia di successo. Sunrise sta creando il suo paesaggio Buy-to-Pay (P2P) attraverso il P2P Optimisation Programme. Un pilastro centrale di questo programma è il Sunrise Buy Desk – un modello di supporto a due posizioni, progettato per fornire un servizio P2P coerente e esperto in ogni business unit. Come P2P Desk Manager, si guida la funzione Zurigo. Non sei un processore di transazione – sei l'autorità operativa che risolve ciò che il supporto automatizzato e di prima linea non può, chiude le autorizzazioni e solleva la barra per le prestazioni P2P attraverso Sunrise. TUA SICUREZZA: - Own the OutcomeBe l'esperto che risolve ciò che il processo standard non può – attraverso domande PR/PO, problemi di fattura, case di fornitore escalation time-critical. Coordina direttamente con Finance, Procurement e Business dove necessario, mantenere piena visibilità degli stakeholder e chiudere ogni caso in modo conforme all'interno di SLA - Impostare le requisizioni di acquisto di Quality BarValidate end-to-end – allineamento dei contratti, delle materie prime, conformità delle politiche, routing di aggiornamento – e guidare la conversione di PO pulita. Applicare lo stesso rigore al vendor onboarding: convalidare il business case, garantire la corretta configurazione di Ariba e dirigere tutta la spesa al canale di acquisto giusto, tra cui SG&A e Consulenza tramite
• Requisiti di Consulenza (ConReq) - Fix Per GoodDon't solo risolvere il problema di oggi, identificare il modello dietro di esso. Tradurre i problemi P2P successivi in iniziative di miglioramento strutturato che si nutrono direttamente nel Programma di Miglioramento P2P e render il processo permanentemente migliore - Costruire Capability, Not DependencyMantenere dati master accurati (precing, cataloghi, termini di pagamento, codici merce) come la base per l'acquisto senza attrito e l'associazione delle fatture. Unità di business del treno e dell'allenatore sulla politica di spesa, così lo fanno la prima volta, ogni volta. Competenze formali dei campioni, contratti e ordini di acquisto per guidare il comportamento di acquisto conformi alla fonte - Misurare Quali sono i KPI operativi MattersTrack (STIP - Straight-Through-Invoice-Processing, Competenze di fattura, Conformità dell'ordine di acquisto, Tempi di acquisto multinazionali), evidenzia tendenze di non conformi e bandiere La diversità non è solo un programma per noi, è parte del DNA. Celebrando le nostre differenze, raggiungiamo grandi cose insieme. Sunrise ha collaborato con «Advance – Gender Equality in Business». Abbiamo anche ricevuto l’etichetta LGBTI svizzero e la certificazione «Fair-ON-Pay Advanced» come riconoscimento per l’offerta di tutti i nostri dipendenti pari paga per lavoro di pari valore. Pronti ad affrontare la sfida? Allora unisciti alla squadra e forma attivamente il nostro futuro! #ChallengersWanted Informazioni per le agenzie: I dossier applicativi inviati o caricati da agenzie di collocamento o simili non sono desiderati, quindi non saranno considerati e saranno eliminati. #LI-NW1 #

Sunrise is transforming its Purchase-to-Pay (P2P) landscape through the P2P Optimisation Programme. A central pillar of this programme is the Sunrise Buying Desk – a two-location, tiered support model designed to deliver consistent, expert P2P service across every business unit.

As P2P Desk Manager, you lead the Zurich function. You are not a transaction processor – you are the operational authority who resolves what automated and first-line support cannot, closes systemic gaps and raises the bar for P2P performance across Sunrise. YOUR CHALLENGE:

- Own the OutcomeBe the expert who resolves what standard process can't – across PR/PO queries, invoice issues, vendor cases and time-critical escalations. Coordinate directly with Finance, Procurement and Business where needed, maintain full stakeholder visibility and close every case compliantly within SLA
- Set the Quality BarValidate purchase requisitions end-to-end – contract alignment, commodity classification, policy compliance, approval routing – and drive clean PO conversion. Apply the same rigour to vendor onboarding: validate the business case, ensure correct Ariba setup and direct all spend to the right buying channel, including SG&A and Consultancy via Consulting Requisitions (ConReq)
- Fix It for GoodDon't just resolve today's issue, identify the pattern behind it. Translate recurring P2P problems into structured improvement initiatives that feed directly into the P2P Improvement Programme and make the process permanently better
- Build Capability, Not DependencyMaintain accurate master data (pricing, catalogues, payment terms, commodity codes) as the foundation for friction-free purchasing and invoice processing. Train and coach business units on the Spend Policy, so they do it right the first time, every time. Champion catalogues, contracts and Purchase Orders to drive compliant buying behaviour at source
- Measure What MattersTrack operational KPIs (STIP – Straight-Through-Invoice-Processing, Invoice compliance, Purchase Order compliance, Vendor onboarding time), report non-compliance trends and flag Category Strategy deviations to the responsible Category Manager – turning data into accountability

YOUR SKILLS:

- Minimum 5 years of hands-on procurement or P2P operations experience in a mid-to-large enterprise, with a track record of managing complex, high-volume transactional environments
- Proficient in SAP S/4HANA; working knowledge of SAP Ariba (Buying, Sourcing or Contracts modules) is a strong advantage
- Solid grasp of end-to-end P2P processes, purchase policy frameworks, escalation management and vendor onboarding – including the ability to distinguish what needs to be resolved vs. what needs to be redesigned
- Analytical mindset: you read case data, identify patterns and translate operational KPIs into concrete improvement actions
- Skilled communicator who can de-escalate urgent situations, influence behaviour without formal authority and engage confidently with senior stakeholders
- Professional procurement/ IT certification is an advantage
- Fluent English and strong German language skills, both written and spoken

At Sunrise, you’ll be working in a dynamic and multinational environment where every voice is heard, perspectives are shared and values are lived. Diversity isn’t just a program for us, it’s part of our DNA. By celebrating our differences, we achieve great things together.

Sunrise has partnered with «Advance – Gender Equality in Business». We’ve also been awarded the Swiss LGBTI label and «Fair-ON-Pay Advanced» certification as recognition for offering all our employees equal pay for work of equal value.

Ready to rise to the challenge? Then join the team and actively shape our future!

Faciliter, négocier et médiateurr entre les équipes techniques et professionnelles afin d'assurer la prise de décisions, d'améliorer la satisfaction de la clientèle et l'efficacité opérationnelle - Plaidoyer auprès des clients : Représenter la voix du client au sein des marques Flanker afin d'améliorer continuellement la satisfaction de la clientèle - Collaboration interfonctionnelle : Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les membres de l'équipe centrale, y compris les gestionnaires de produits, les PM d'affaires, les PM IT, les formateurs, les développeurs et les testeurs - Aller en direct Support : Tests d'acceptation par l'utilisateur principal (TAU) et validations d'entreprise pour s'assurer que les solutions répondent aux besoins opérationnels et aux attentes des clients VOS SKILLS : - Au moins 3 ans d'expérience en analyse d'entreprise ou en gestion de processus et de projets, de préférence dans le domaine des télécommunications - Expérience de travail avec les méthodologies Agile et/ou Waterfall - Forte attention accordée à l'expérience client et à l'amélioration des processus avec un premier état d'esprit numérique - Thinker analytique avec une approche proactive, orientée vers la solution et la capacité d'adaptation aux besoins opérationnels changeants La diversité n'est pas seulement un programme pour nous, elle fait partie de notre ADN. descriptionByLocale.fr: Nous, à Sunrise, pensons grand, allons plus loin et créons de nouvelles choses. Pour nous, la culture du travail signifie : faire de grandes choses ensemble. C'est ici le vrai respect et les nouvelles idées rencontrent un travail d'équipe : chaque voix compte, chaque perspective nous rend plus forts. Notre passion nous pousse à essayer de nouvelles choses et à grandir. Vous ressemblez à vous? Ensuite, il devient partie intégrante de notre histoire de réussite. Nos héros en première ligne sont les fleurs tout-trop Sunrise. Ils gagnent des points avec des solutions personnalisées et un excellent service, donc chaque contact avec le client devient une connexion à long terme. VOS DÉFIS : - Construisez des relations à long terme avec les clients et assurons une atmosphère de première classe dans le magasin. - Soutenez les clients avec des problèmes de réparation et de service et agissez de façon professionnelle et de manière provisoire à la solution. - Suivez l'entrepôt et stockez et exécutez efficacement les activités administratives. - Vivi et moi représentons les valeurs de Sun1 : innovation, proximité avec le client et excellent service. Vos concurrents : - Vous avez suivi une formation dans le commerce de détail, idéalement expérimenté dans le secteur des télécommunications ou multimédia - ou vous êtes motivé à changer de carrière avec des talents pour la vente. - Non Être débordant d'enthousiasme pour la technologie, les télécommunications et les tendances numériques. - Votre passion pour les ventes est évidente et votre comportement professionnel aster ii un véritable professionnel de la vente. - Vous aimez traiter avec les gens et vous avez la capacité de reconnaître rapidement leurs yeux. - Grâce à votre patience et à votre compréhension technique, vous naîtra un quotidien pour nos clients. - Vous avez une grande connaissance de l'allemand, toute langue supplémentaire est un avantage. - Il offre beaucoup de flexibilité, de fiabilité et d'ouverture à une industrie en évolution rapide. Dans Sunrise vous travaillerez dans un environnement intermédiaire et multinational où chaque voix est entendue, les perspectives et les valeurs suivantes sont mesurées. L'entreprise est partenaire de.Advanced Gender Equality in Business., propriétaire de la marque suisse LGBTI et certifié avec.Fair-ON-Pay Advance. pour un salaire égal pour un travail égal de valeur pour tous. Ensuite, rejoignez l'équipe et façonner activement notre avenir! #ChallengersNote attendue pour les agences: les documents de demande ou téléchargés par des agences de placement ou similaires ne sont pas souhaités et ne seront donc pas pris en considération et seront éliminés. #LI-TW1 #

In dieser Rolle übernimmst du die technische Verantwortung für alle MySports IT- & OTT-Systeme und stellst sicher, dass diese für den operativen Betrieb reibungslos funktionieren. Zudem verantwortest du die Weiterentwicklung unserer gesamten Systemlandschaft.

Du arbeitest an der Schnittstelle zwischen Business, Streaming-Technologie, App-Entwicklung, CRM und Broadcast und sorgst dafür, dass alle Systeme optimal zusammenspielen. DEINE CHALLENGE:

- Technische Verantwortung & Betrieb:Sicherstellung eines stabilen und reibungslosen Betriebs der MySports App und aller angebundenen Systeme inkl. Monitoring der Systemperformance sowie proaktive Identifikation und Eskalation von Issues (insbesondere bei Live-Events)
- Systemintegration & Datenflüsse:Verantwortung für das Zusammenspiel der gesamten Systemlandschaft sowie Sicherstellung sauberer Datenflüsse zwischen App, CRM und Backend-Systemen inkl. Schnittstellenverantwortung zur OTT-Plattform sowie zu Broadcast-, Content- und EPG-Systemen
- Solution Design & Requirements Engineering:Übersetzung von Business-Anforderungen in klare, umsetzbare technische Requirements sowie Sicherstellung einer strukturierten und vollständigen Anforderungsdefinition
- Vendor Setup & Steuerung:Federführende Auswahl sowie Koordination und Steuerung externer Technologiepartner und Lieferanten (z. B. App, CRM, Payment, Analytics) in Abstimmung mit Procurement, Legal und Security
- Implementation & Delivery Management:End-to-End Verantwortung für die Einführung, Integration und Weiterentwicklung von Systemen und Features inkl. Planung, Koordination und Durchführung von Testing (inkl. UAT) bis zum erfolgreichen Go-Live
- Go-Live & Operational Handover:Übergabe neuer Systeme und Features an Operations inkl. Dokumentation sowie Sicherstellung eines stabilen Betriebs und Begleitung der initialen Betriebsphase
- Weiterentwicklung & Optimierung:Verantwortung für die Gesamtübersicht der Systemlandschaft inkl. Identifikation von Optimierungsbedarf, Definition und kontinuierliche Optimierung von technischen Prozessen sowie Evaluation neuer Technologien (z. B. im Bereich OTT, Automatisierung, AI)

DEINE SKILLS:

- Erfahrung in einer technischen Produktmanager-, Plattform- oder System-Integrationsrolle
- Gutes Verständnis von OTT-/Streaming-Plattformen; Verständnis von digitalen Subscription-Modellen von Vorteil
- Erfahrung im Umgang mit APIs & Systemintegrationen sowie CRM-, Payment- oder Analytics-Systemen
- Grundverständnis von Datenstrukturen, Datenflüssen sowie Software-Development-Prozessen (Agile, Releases, Testing)
- Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Requirements Engineering inkl. Priorisierung und Stakeholder-Management
- Strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise
- Fähigkeit, komplexe technische Themen verständlich zu vermitteln
- Hohes Verantwortungsbewusstsein („Ownership“) sowie proaktive und hands-on Mentalität
- Fähigkeit, verschiedene Stakeholder (Business, Tech, externe Partner) zu koordinieren
- Interesse an neuen Technologien (insb. OTT, CRM, Automatisierung, AI)
- Sehr gute Deutsch- sowie gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Bei Sunrise arbeitest du in einem dynamischen und multinationalen Umfeld, in dem jede Stimme gehört, Perspektiven geteilt und Werte gelebt werden. Vielfalt ist für uns nicht nur ein Programm, sondern Teil unserer DNA. Weil wir unsere Unterschiede feiern, erreichen wir gemeinsam Grosses.

Progettare, valutare ed eseguire offerte speciali e incentivi che si allineano alle esigenze del cliente e agli obiettivi aziendali - Segmentazione del cliente. Sviluppare strategie di segmentazione per esigenze le azioni di prevenzione e aumentare la pertinenza e l'efficacia dell'offerta - Monitoraggio delle prestazioni. Tracciare l'impatto delle attività di prevenzione e delle offerte; affinare ripetutamente le strategie basate su KPI e feedback - Collaborazione interfunzionale. a stretto contatto con Gestione Base, Retention Frontline, Team NPS e Marketing per allineare le tattiche di apparent, condividere informazioni sui clienti e risolvere i clienti. - Insights & Reporting del cliente. Analizza il feedback dei clienti, le tendenze di utilizzo e i motivi di curno per supportare il processo previsto sui dati - Ottimizzazione dei processi. Migliorare le prospettive di lavoro di prevenzione dei curni, strumenti e strumenti per la mobilità e l'efficienza I TUOI SKILLS: - Laurea in Business Administration, Marketing, o un campo correlato - Esperienza di Proven (3+ anni) in conservazione dei clienti, Gestione di base, Gestione del valore o campo corretarielato - Forte capacità analitiche con la capacità di interpretare dati complessi e modelli di comportamento dei clienti La diversità programma non solo parte per affrontare #ChalengersWanted Informazioni per agenzie: I fascicoli di candidatura o caricati da agenzie di collocamento o simili non sono desiderati, quindi non saranno considerati e saranno eliminati. #LI-ST1

descriptionByLocale.en: At Sunrise, we think bigger, go further and create new ideas. For us working culture means achieving great things together. It’s where respect and innovative ideas combine with real teamwork – every voice counts, every perspective makes us stronger. Our passion spurs us on to try new things and grow continuously. Sound like you? Then join our success story. As the B2B Prevention & Retention Manager, you are responsible for proactively identifying at-risk customers and deploying targeted retention strategies and campaigns, with special offers to reduce churn. You will leverage data insights, customer behavior, and close collaboration with B2B Frontline Retention, Base Management, Analytics, and NPS teams to drive retention initiatives, ensuring long-term customer satisfaction and value. YOUR CHALLENGE: - Churn Prevention Strategy – Identify customers with a high risk of churn through data analysis and implement tailored retention campaigns - Churn Prevention Execution – Conduct briefings, listen in on customer calls, evaluate customer escalations as needed, ensure the quality of the operational campaign. Design, evaluate, and execute special offers and incentives that align with customer needs and company goals - Customer Segmentation – Develop segmentation strategies to personalize prevention actions and increase offer relevance and effectiveness - Performance Monitoring – Track the impact of prevention activities and offers; continuously refine strategies based on KPIs and feedback - Cross-functional Collaboration – Work closely with Base Management, Retention Frontline, NPS Team and Marketing to align retention tactics, share customer insights and solve customer interactions. - Customer Insights & Reporting – Analyze customer feedback, usage trends, and churn reasons to support data-driven decision-making - Process Optimization – Continuously improve churn prevention workflows, tools, and automation for scalability and efficiency YOUR SKILLS: - Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field - Proven experience (3+ years) in customer retention, Base Management, Value Management, or related field - Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex data and customer behavior patterns - Excellent communication and negotiation skills, with a customer-centric mindset - Ability to work cross-functionally and drive initiatives in a fast-paced environment - Strategic thinker with hands-on execution ability and a proactive approach to problem-solving - Fluent in German and English, Italian and French is a plus At Sunrise, you’ll be working in a dynamic and multinational environment where every voice is heard, perspectives are shared and values are lived. Diversity isn’t just a program for us, it’s part of our DNA. By celebrating our differences, we achieve great things together. Sunrise has partnered with «Advance – Gender Equality in Business». We’ve also been awarded the Swiss LGBTI label and «Fair-ON-Pay Advanced» certification as recognition for offering all our employees equal pay for work of equal value. Ready to rise to the challenge? Per noi cultura del lavoro significa: realizzare grandi cose insieme. è qui vero rispetto e le nuove idee incontro un lavoro di squadra: ogni voce conta, ogni prospettiva ci rende più forti. La nostra passione ci spinge a provare cose nuove e a crescere. Sembri te? Allora diventa parte della nostra storia di successo. I nostri eroi in prima linea sono i fiori all’occhiello di Sunrise. Guadagnano punti con soluzioni su misura e un servizio eccellente, così ogni contatto con il cliente diventa una connessione a lungo termine. LA TUA SFIDA: - Sei il volto di Sunrise e ispiri i nostri clienti con il tuo carisma positivo, i tuoi consigli mirati e la vendita dei nostri diversi prodotti Sunrise. - Costruisci rapporti a lungo termine con i clienti e garantisci un'atmosfera di prima classe nel negozio. - Supporti i clienti con problemi di riparazione e assistenza e agisci in modo professionale e orientale alla soluzione. - Tieni traccia del magazzino e dell'inventario e svolgi le attività amministrative in modo efficiente. - Vivi e rappresentai i valori Sunrise: innovazione, vicinanza al cliente e servizio eccellente. LE TUE COMPETENZE: - Hai completato la formazione nel settore della vendita al dettaglio, idealmente con esperienza nel settore delle telecomunicazioni o multimediale - oppure è un motivato al cambio di carriera con talento per la vendita. - No Essere traboccante di entusiasmo per la tecnologia, le telecomunicazioni e le tendenze digitali. - La tua passione per le vendite è evidente e il tuo comportamento professionale render un vero professionista delle vendite. - Ti piace avere a che fare con le persone e hai la capacità di riconoscere rapidamente i loro occhi. - Grazie alla tua pazienza e comprensione tecnica, nascerai un quotidiano per i nostri clienti. - Hai un'ottima conoscenza del tedesco, qualsiasi lingua aggiuntiva è un vantaggio. - Apporta molta flessibilità, affidabilità e apertura a un settore in evoluzione rapida. In Sunrise lavorerai in un ambiente intermedio e multinazionale dove ogni voce viene ascoltata, le prospettive successive e i valori vengono vissuti. Per noi la diversità non è solo un programma, ma parte del nostro DNA. Di protagonista preferito le nostre differenze, idea reali grandi cose insieme. Sunrise è partner di “Advance Gender Equality in Business”, titolare del marchio svizzero LGBTI e certificata con “Fair-ON-Pay Advanced” per la parità di retribuzione per un lavoro di uguale valore per tutti. Sei pronto per la sfida? Allora entra a far parte del team e plasma attivamente il nostro futuro! #ChallengersWanted Nota per le agenzie: i documenti di candidatura o caricati da agenzie di collocamento o simili non sono desiderati e quindi non verranno presi in considerazione e verranno eliminati. #LI-TW1 #

YOUR CHALLENGE: - Sei the face of Sunrise and inspire our customers with your positive charisma, targeted advice and sales of our various Sun1 products. - Build long-term relationships with customers and ensure a first-class atmosphere in the store. - Support customers with repair and service problems and act professionally and orientally to the solution. - Track the warehouse and inventory and perform administrative activities efficiently. - Vivi and I represent the values of Sun1 1: innovation, closeness to the customer and excellent service. YOUR COMPETENCES: - You have completed training in retail, ideally experienced in the telecommunications or multimedia sector - or you are motivated to change career with talent for sales. - No Being overflowing with enthusiasm for technology, telecommunications and digital trends. - Your passion for sales is obvious and your professional behavior aster ii a true sales professional. - You like dealing with people and you have the ability to quickly recognize their eyes. - Thanks to your patience and technical understanding, you will be born a daily newspaper for our customers. - You have a great knowledge of German, any additional language is an advantage. - It provides a lot of flexibility, reliability and openness to a rapidly evolving industry. Dans Sunrise vous travaillerez dans un environnement intermédiaire et multinational où chaque voix est entendue, les perspectives et les valeurs suivantes sont mesurées. jobs.title: AI/ML Engineer & MLOps 80-100%
jobs.description:
Un Sunrise pensa più in grande, andiamo oltre e creiamo idee nuove. Per noi lavorare cultura significa realizzare grandi cose insieme. E' dove il rispetto e le idee innovative si combinano con il vero lavoro di squadra. ogni voce conta, prospettiva ogni ci rende più forti. La nostra passione ci spinge a provare cose nuove e crescere rapidamente. Suona come te? Poi uniscivi alla nostra storia di successo. A ADAO (AI, Data e 1996,c Enablement Office), insieme le persone per arrivare al futuro di Sunrise attraverso i dati, l'analisi, AI, e '41.

Pensiamo in grande, ci muoviamo con lo scopo e trasformaiamo le idee in un reale impatto per i nostri clienti e team. L'ADAO è dove l'innovazione incontra fiducia: costruiamo solide basi dati, scalamo capacità AI sicuro e affidabili e esponiamo le business unit attraverso un modello operativo hub-and-spoke per avere significato in tutta l'azienda.

All'interno di questo modello, lavorerete come parte del team di Abilitazione e Prompt Engineering & Conversation Design, che si occupa di standard, piattaforme, architettura e migliori pratiche, mentre i Pod cross-funzionali e guidati dai risultati sono integrati e guidati dall'azienda. Vi individui da esperti ingegneristici, collaborando con l'azienda per raggiungere le loro priorità e risultati.

In questo ruolo, progettato, diretto, distribuisce e controllato soluzioni di grado di grado ML e GenAI, compresi i componenti RAG, ove applicabile, che garantiscono un valore commerciale misurabile per Sunrise, garantito l'eccellenza del ciclo di vita end-to-end dalla sperimentazione all'implementazioneta, monitoraggio, controlli dei rischi e miglioramento continuo in allineamento con gli standard ADAO e governance. Farai parte del ADAO, supportando i Domain Pod incorporati attraverso componenti di capitolo riutilizzabili, standard ingegneristici e consegne pratiche.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Sunrise, we think bigger, go further and create new ideas. For us working culture means achieving great things together. It’s where respect and innovative ideas combine with real teamwork – every voice counts, every perspective makes us stronger. Our passion spurs us on to try new things and grow continuously. Sound like you? Then join our success story.

At ADAO (AI, Data and Agentic Enablement Office), we bring people together to unlock the future of Sunrise through data, analytics, AI, and agentic technologies. We think big, move with purpose, and turn ideas into real impact for our customers and teams. ADAO is where innovation meets trust: we build strong data foundations, scale safe and reliable AI capabilities, and empower business units through a hub‑and‑spoke operating model to deliver meaningful results across the company. Within this model, you will work as part of the Agentic Enablement and Prompt Engineering & Conversation Design team, where the central hub provides standards, platforms, architecture, and best practices, while cross‑functional, outcome‑driven Pods are embedded in and led by the business. You will act as an engineering expert, partnering closely with the business to deliver on their priorities and outcomes.

In this role you will design, build, deploy and operate production grade ML and GenAI solutions, including RAG components where applicable, that deliver measurable business value for Sunrise, ensuring end-to-end lifecycle excellence from experimentation to automated deployment, monitoring, risk controls and continuous improvement in alignment with ADAO standards and governance.

You will be part of the central AI/ML Engineering & MLOps chapter within the ADAO Hub, supporting embedded Domain Pods through reusable platform components, engineering standards and hands-on delivery.

YOUR CHALLENGE:

- Run evaluation harnesses for ML & GenAI (regression, A/B tests, safety & multilingual checks) and share reusable assets

- Implement Responsible AI / GenAI guardrails: grounding, HITL approvals, audit logs, and risk reviews with governance teams

- Maintain runbooks, participate in on-call/incident postmortems, and drive corrective actions

- Build reusable libraries and reference implementations (RAG connectors, evaluation utilities, deployment scaffolding)
- Coach Pod engineers through reviews, pairing and clinics; contribute to ADAO AI Academy materials

- Key deliverables (illustrative):Standard ML/LLMOps pipeline template + reference architectures (batch/real-time/RAG)Model registry & artefact versioning (models, prompts, datasets, features)Monitoring dashboards + drift detection + SLO reportingGenAI evaluation test suite (regression, safety, multilingual) and acceptance thresholdsModel documentation pack and operational runbooks (audit-ready)
- Standard ML/LLMOps pipeline template + reference architectures (batch/real-time/RAG)
- Model registry & artefact versioning (models, prompts, datasets, features)
- Monitoring dashboards + drift detection + SLO reporting
- GenAI evaluation test suite (regression, safety, multilingual) and acceptance thresholds
- Model documentation pack and operational runbooks (audit-ready)

YOUR SKILLS:

- Bachelor’s/Master’s in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or equivalent practical experience
- 3+ years in ML engineering, MLOps, software/data engineering or related roles, with proven end-to-end production of ML/GenAI solutions
- Hands‑on CI/CD and DevOps for ML workloads (testing, version control, release management), plus IaC (Terraform/Pulumi) and GitOps
- Experience with ML frameworks (scikit‑learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow) and serving patterns (REST/gRPC, batch, streaming), and MLOps tooling (MLflow, Kubeflow, Azure ML, Vertex AI, SageMaker)
- Strong Python software engineering (testing, APIs), containers (Docker) and cloud deployment patterns; GenAI/RAG experience is a plus
- Familiarity with feature stores, experiment tracking, data quality testing and orchestration tools (Airflow/Dagster/Prefect), working in cross-functional Hub and Pod setups
- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, ownership mindset and reliability under pressure with a structured engineering approach
- Ability to influence without formal authority, champion standards across Hub and Pods, and continuously adapt to evolving AI/ML technologies; telecommunications experience is a plus

jobs.description:
Un alba, pensare più grande, andare oltre e creare nuove cose. Per noi, lavorare la cultura significa creare grandi cose insieme. Qui il rispetto e le Idee precedenti il lavoro di squadra reale – ogni voce conta, ogni prospettiva ci rende più forti. La nostra passione ci spinge a osare cose nuove e a crescere. Ti sembra? Allora parte diventa della nostra storia di successo.

I nostri eroi di prima linea sono l'ammiraglia di Sunrise. Punteggi con soluzioni personalizzate e servizio superiore - così ogni contatto clientela diventa una connessione a lungo termine.

La tua:

- Siete il volto di Sunrise e ispirate i nostri clienti con il vostro carisma positivo, il vostro consiglio mirato e la vendita dei nostri diversi prodotti Sunrise.
- Costruisci relazioni con i clienti a lungo termine e fornisci un'atmosfera di prima classe nel negozio.
- Supporti i clienti con problemi di riparazione e servizio e agisci professionalmente e orientaleta alla soluzione.
- Si tiene traccia di magazzino e inventario e compiti amministrativi in modo efficiente.
- Vivi e rappresentai i valori Sunrise – innovazione, prossimità del cliente e servizio eccellente.

I tuoi omicidi:

- Hai completato un apprendistato nel commercio al dettaglio, idealmente con esperienza nell'industria delle telecomunicazioni o multimediale – o è un avversario laterale motivato con un tocco di vendita.
- Con entusiasmo per la tecnologia, le telecomunicazioni e le tendenze digitali.
- La tua passione per le vendite è evidente e il tuo aspetto professionale ti rende un vero professionista delle vendite.
- Ti piace trattare con le persone e la capacità di riconoscere rapidamente i loro occhi.
- Grazie alla vostra pazienza e comprensione tecnica, diventerete un eroe di tutti i giorni per i nostri clienti.
- Avete una buona conoscenza del tedesco, ogni altra lingua è un plus.
- Porti molta flessibilità, affidabilità e apertura a un settore rapido in evoluzione.

A Sunrise, si lavora in un ambiente dinamico e multinazionale dove ogni voce viene ascoltata, le prospettive sono coindise e i valori sono vissuti. La diversità non è solo un programma per noi, ma parte del nostro DNA. Perché celebriamo le nostre differenze, otte grandi cose insieme.

Sunrise è un partner di Advance Gender Equality in Business, l'etichetta LGBTI svizzera e certificata con Fair-ON-Pay Advanced per un lavoro di pari valore per tutti.

Sei pronto per la sfida? Allora parte diventa del team e forma attivamente il nostro futuro!

descriptionByLocale.en:
Description

An dawn, seemingly bigger, to go beyond and create new things. For us, working on culture means creating great things together. Here, respect and ideas take precedence over real teamwork – every voice counts, every perspective makes us stronger. Our passion drives us to dare new things and grow. Does that sound like you? Then become part of our success story. Our frontline heroes are Sunrise’s flagship. Achieve success with customized solutions and superior service – so every customer contact becomes a long-term connection.

Responsibilities

- You are the face of Sunrise and inspire our customers with your positive charisma, targeted advice, and the sale of our various Sunrise products.
- Build long-term relationships with customers and provide a first-class atmosphere in the store.
- Support customers with repair and service issues and act professionally and oriented towards solutions.
- Keep track of stock and inventory and handle administrative tasks efficiently.
- Live and represent the values of Sunrise – innovation, proximity to the customer, and excellent service.

Requirements

- You have completed an apprenticeship in retail, ideally with experience in the telecommunications or multimedia industry – or are a motivated lateral entrant with a touch of sales.
- Enthusiastic about technology, telecommunications, and digital trends.
- Your passion for sales is evident, and your professional appearance makes you a true sales professional.
- You enjoy dealing with people and can quickly recognize their needs.
- Thanks to your patience and technical understanding, you will become a daily hero for our customers.
- You have good knowledge of German; any other language is a plus.
- You bring a lot of flexibility, reliability, and openness to a fast-evolving sector.

What we offer

- At Sunrise, we work in a dynamic and multinational environment where every voice is heard, perspectives are shared, and values are lived.
- Diversity is not just a program for us but part of our DNA.
- Because we celebrate our differences, we achieve great things together.
- Sunrise is a partner of Advance Gender Equality in Business, the Swiss LGBTI label, and certified with Fair-ON-Pay Advanced for equal work for all.

Contact

Are you ready for the challenge? Then become part of the team and actively shape our future!

#ChallengersWanted

descriptionByLocale.de:
Beschreibung

Ein Morgengrauen, das scheinbar größer ist, um darüber hinauszugehen und Neues zu schaffen. Für uns bedeutet Kulturarbeit, Großes gemeinsam zu erschaffen. Hier stehen Respekt und Ideen vor echtem Teamgeist – jede Stimme zählt, jede Perspektive macht uns stärker. Unsere Leidenschaft treibt uns an, Neues zu wagen und zu wachsen. Klingt das nach dir? Dann werde Teil unserer Erfolgsgeschichte. Unsere Frontline-Helden sind die Flaggschiffe von Sunrise. Erziele Erfolg mit maßgeschneiderten Lösungen und erstklassigem Service – so wird jeder Kundenkontakt zu einer langfristigen Verbindung.

Aufgaben

- Du bist das Gesicht von Sunrise und begeisterst unsere Kunden mit deinem positiven Charisma, gezielter Beratung und dem Verkauf unserer verschiedenen Sunrise-Produkte.
- Baue langfristige Kundenbeziehungen auf und schaffe eine erstklassige Atmosphäre im Geschäft.
- Unterstütze Kunden bei Reparatur- und Serviceproblemen und handle professionell und lösungsorientiert.
- Behalte Lagerbestand und Inventar im Blick und erledige administrative Aufgaben effizient.
- Lebe und vertrete die Werte von Sunrise – Innovation, Kundennähe und exzellenten Service.

Anforderungen

- Du hast eine Ausbildung im Einzelhandel abgeschlossen, idealerweise mit Erfahrung in der Telekommunikations- oder Multimedia-Branche – oder bist ein motivierter Quereinsteiger mit Verkaufstalent.
- Begeisterung für Technologie, Telekommunikation und digitale Trends.
- Deine Leidenschaft für den Verkauf ist sichtbar, und dein professionelles Auftreten macht dich zu einem echten Verkaufsexperten.
- Du magst den Umgang mit Menschen und kannst ihre Bedürfnisse schnell erkennen.
- Dank deiner Geduld und technischen Verständnis wirst du zum Alltagshelden unserer Kunden.
- Du hast gute Deutschkenntnisse; jede weitere Sprache ist ein Plus.
- Du bringst viel Flexibilität, Zuverlässigkeit und Offenheit für einen schnelllebigen Bereich mit.

Was wir bieten

- Bei Sunrise arbeiten wir in einem dynamischen und multikulturellen Umfeld, in dem jede Stimme gehört wird, Perspektiven geteilt werden und Werte gelebt werden.
- Vielfalt ist für uns nicht nur ein Programm, sondern Teil unserer DNA.
- Weil wir unsere Unterschiede feiern, erreichen wir gemeinsam Großes.
- Sunrise ist Partner von Advance Gender Equality in Business, dem Schweizer LGBTI-Label, und zertifiziert mit Fair-ON-Pay Advanced für gleiche Arbeit für alle.

Kontakt

Bist du bereit für die Herausforderung? Dann werde Teil unseres Teams und gestalte aktiv unsere Zukunft!

#ChallengersWanted

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Sunrise, we think bigger, go further and create new things. For us, working culture means creating big things together. Here, respect and fresh ideas meet real teamwork – every voice counts, every perspective makes us stronger. Our passion drives us to dare new things and grow constantly. Sounds like you? Then become part of our success story. Our front line heroes are the flagship of Sunrise. They score with tailor-made solutions and top service - so every customer contact becomes a long-term connection.

Your team is working on your team, you are developing your team, you are recognizing talents and promoting them. - The inviting appearance of your shop is at your heart. - You have the most important figures in mind: sales, stock management, inventory and cash registers are in complete control. - You are not only team leader, but also salespersons of your own soul and you are acting as a model with your positive mindset.

- Customer loyalty is not a foreign word for you – you provide for top customer experiences and long-term relationships. - You implement the strategy of the region on the front line and make your shop a real success story. DEINE SKILLS: - You have completed professional training in retail trade, preferably with a training in sales or leadership. - You are a sales professional and have many years of experience in motivating and developing a team.

- You know the advantages and peculiarities of a dynamic industry and ideally bring knowledge from the telecommunications industry. - You want to manage your own success: Our variable wage share motivates you and your shop to achieve maximum performance. - Service and customer focus are a matter of course for you, so you also promote the service orientation of your employees. - You bringt with you a total of nineteen German languages, each other is a plus.

At Sunrise, you work in a dynamic and multi-faceted environment where every voice belongs, perspectives are shared and values are lived. Diversity is not just a program for us, but part of our DNA. Because we celebrate our differences, we achieve a big deal together. Sunrise is a partner of Advance Gender Equality in Business, a partner of the Swiss LGBTI label and certified with Fair-ON-Pay Advanced for equal pay for equal work for all. Are you ready for the challenge? Then become part of the team and actively shape our future!

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Sunrise denken wir grösser, gehen weiter und schaffen Neues. Für uns bedeutet Arbeitskultur: gemeinsam Grosses schaffen. Hier treffen Respekt und frische Ideen auf echtes Teamwork – jede Stimme zählt, jede Perspektive macht uns stärker. Unsere Leidenschaft treibt uns an, Neues zu wagen und ständig zu wachsen. Klingt nach dir? Dann werde Teil unserer Erfolgsgeschichte.

Unsere Front-Line-Heroes sind das Aushängeschild von Sunrise. Sie punkten mit massgeschneiderten Lösungen und Top-Service - so wird aus jedem Kundenkontakt eine langfristige Connection.

DEINE CHALLENGE:

- Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für den gesamten Shop – von der Teamführung bis zur Umsatzsteigerung.
- Du coachst und entwickelst dein Team, erkennst Talente und förderst sie gezielt.
- Das einladende Erscheinungsbild deines Shops liegt dir persönlich am Herzen.
- Du hast die wichtigsten Zahlen im Blick: Umsatz, Stock Management, Inventur und Kasse hast du voll im Griff.
- Du bist nicht nur Teamleiter/-in, sondern auch selbst Verkäufer/-in aus Leib und Seele und agierst mit deinem positiven Mindset als Vorbild.
- Kundenbindung ist für dich kein Fremdwort – du sorgst für Top-Kundenerlebnisse und langfristige Beziehungen.
- Du setzt die Strategie der Region an vorderster Front um und machst aus deinem Shop eine echte Erfolgsstory.

DEINE SKILLS:

- Du verfügst über eine abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung im Detailhandel, vorzugsweise mit einer Weiterbildung im Bereich Verkauf oder in der Führung.
- Du bist ein Sales-Profi und hast mehrjährige Erfahrung darin, ein Team zu motivieren und weiterzuentwickeln.
- Du kennst die Vorzüge und Eigenheiten einer dynamischen Branche und bringst idealerweise Kenntnisse aus der Telekommunikationsbranche mit.
- Du willst deinen eigenen Erfolg steuern: Unser variabler Lohnanteil motiviert dich und deinen Shop zu Höchstleistungen.
- Service und Kundenfokus sind für dich eine Selbstverständlichkeit, deshalb förderst du auch die Dienstleistungsorientierung deiner Mitarbeitenden.
- Du bringst fliessende Deutschkenntnisse mit, jede weitere Sprache ist ein Plus.

Bei Sunrise arbeitest du in einem dynamischen und multinationalen Umfeld, in dem jede Stimme gehört, Perspektiven geteilt und Werte gelebt werden. Vielfalt ist für uns nicht nur ein Programm, sondern Teil unserer DNA. Weil wir unsere Unterschiede feiern, erreichen wir gemeinsam Grosses.

Sunrise ist Partner von «Advance Gender Equality in Business», Träger des Schweizer LGBTI-Labels und mit «Fair-ON-Pay Advanced» für die gleiche Bezahlung gleichwertiger Arbeit für alle zertifiziert.

- Vous vivez et représentez les valeurs de Sunrise – innovation, proximité avec le client et service excellent.

Vos qualités :

- Vous avez terminé un apprentissage dans le commerce de détail, idéalement avec une expérience dans l'industrie des télécommunications ou du multimédia – ou vous êtes un motivé reconverti avec un talent pour la vente.
- Vous avez de l'enthousiasme pour la technologie, les télécommunications et les tendances numériques.

- Vous apportez beaucoup de flexibilité, de fiabilité et d'ouverture à un secteur en évolution rapide.

Chez Sunrise, nous travaillons dans un environnement dynamique et multinationale où chaque voix est entendue, les perspectives sont partagées et les valeurs sont vécues. descriptionByLocale.en:
At Sunrise, we think bigger, go further and create new ideas. For us working culture means achieving great things together. It’s where respect and innovative ideas combine with real teamwork – every voice counts, every perspective makes us stronger. Our passion spurs us on to try new things and grow continuously. Sound like you? Then join our success story.

As a Lead Generation Specialist, you identify and acquire qualified business contacts. With your strong understanding of B2B markets, your data-driven approach, and your excellent communication skills, you unlock new sales potential and actively contribute to the sustainable growth of our company.

YOUR CHALLENGE:

- Identify and proactively approach potential business customers
- Develop and implement lead generation strategies and prepare qualified contacts
- Schedule appointments and hand them over to the sales team
- Develop tailored solutions based on customer needs
- Build and maintain long-term customer relationships
- Collaborate closely with the marketing team to execute sales campaigns
- Use CRM and analytics tools to optimize and streamline processes

YOUR SKILLS:

- Experience in sales, telemarketing, or B2B lead generation
- Strong communication and negotiation skills
- Proficiency in using CRM systems and digital sales tools
- Independent, structured, and goal-oriented working style
- Analytical thinking and strong problem-solving abilities
- Team-oriented with a high level of assertiveness
- Very good German skills and good English skills, both written and spoken

At Sunrise, you’ll be working in a dynamic and multinational environment where every voice is heard, perspectives are shared and values are lived. Diversity isn’t just a program for us, it’s part of our DNA. By celebrating our differences, we achieve great things together.

Sunrise has partnered with «Advance – Gender Equality in Business». We’ve also been awarded the Swiss LGBTI label and «Fair-ON-Pay Advanced» certification as recognition for offering all our employees equal pay for work of equal value.

Ready to rise to the challenge? Then join the team and actively shape our future!
